subject.title: Expose structured progress metrics in hook events for plugin-based live progress cards

question: Should OpenClaw add structured progress metrics to existing plugin hook events, and which runtime source owns step totals, percentages, ETA, and terminal metrics across run producers?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the change creates a public Plugin SDK progress contract and naive percentages could mislead plugin UIs.

options.title: Define Narrow Metrics Contract
options.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime has authoritative values, with absent-value semantics and tests across the affected producers.

options.title: Keep Hooks Phase-Oriented
options.body: Leave plugins to derive progress from existing tool and lifecycle hooks until a stronger source of truth exists.

options.title: Design Separate Progress Events
options.body: Create a dedicated progress or process-event contract instead of attaching percentages to existing hook payloads.

recommendation.title: Define Narrow Metrics Contract
recommendation.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime has authoritative values, with absent-value semantics and tests across the affected producers.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-history trail for public hook contract changes points to this handle.
